_comment: An example check pack for run_custom_checks: copy it next to your .PrjPcb (or to the root of the Git repository) as check_packs.json, or into a check_packs folder, and change the rules to your team's. Keys starting with '_' are comments.
title: Team basics: the roadmap's example rules
description: Protection on off-board lines, decoupling distance, capacitor voltage headroom, I2C pull-ups, small parts on the bottom side, manufacturer part numbers, and one tool rule.

rules.title: Every off-board connector signal has a TVS or ESD diode
rules.description: The lines into the board of connectors check_interfaces judges user-facing (signal pins whose line reaches an IC, a transistor or another active part: the lines its no_esd asks protection for; not grounds, supplies, LED or centre-tap pins) reach a TVS/ESD part on the net or across one series part (0 ohm link, resistor, ferrite, choke, series capacitor). Use the class off_board for every connector, board-to-board ones too.

rules.title: Every IC power pin has a decoupling capacitor within 5 mm
rules.description: Each supply pin of a fitted IC on a rail has a fitted capacitor to ground on the same net within 5 mm, pad edge to pad edge (needs the PcbDoc).

rules.title: Capacitors on nets above 24 V are rated at least twice the voltage
rules.description: Rated voltage over the voltage across the capacitor (check_derating's reading of both); give the pack's rails for inputs whose voltage the net name does not say.
rules.message: {designator} on {net}: rated {rated_voltage} V for {voltage} V across it ({ratio:.2f}x, 2x wanted)

rules.title: Every I2C line has exactly one pull-up
rules.description: Each SDA and SCL line (the net with the nets joined to it by series resistors under 1 kohm, as check_pull_resistors joins them; one finding per line) has exactly one fitted resistor to a supply (a rail, or a net a GPIO switches that feeds two or more pull-ups): one pull-up pair per bus.

rules.title: No 0201 or smaller parts on the bottom side
Every part has a manufacturer and a manufacturer part number
rules.description: Fitted BOM parts that should carry one (check_bom's reading: not an Altium mechanical part, not marked N/A on purpose; heat sinks and screws placed as standard parts are bought too), other than test points and fiducials.

rules.title: No user-facing connector line without ESD protection (check_interfaces)
rules.description: A tool rule: check_interfaces' no_esd findings on connectors it judges external become errors of this pack.

fail.label: user-facing connector lines without ESD protection
